rules: Assign complete hands only after boundary annotation; a segment is not a hand.
A calibration or holdout hand must lie wholly within one candidate range.
Do not train, choose templates, tune thresholds or alter geometry from held-out frames.
Boundary annotation is permitted; do not use recognition results to cherry-pick easy hands.
Hands intersecting previously viewed preview frames are development only.
An unreviewed range may contain no eligible complete hands and does not count as acceptance.
Same-session holdout is not independent-device or independent-session validation.
